_meta.title: Countries named in the UN Special Rapporteur on minority issues report on caste and analogous systems of inherited status (A/HRC/31/56, 2016)
_meta.what: Countries the report names in its "Global overview of caste-affected groups" (paragraphs 31-45), with the paragraph and the group it names. The report says its examples "are not exhaustive". Paragraph 31: "over 250 million people suffer from caste-based discrimination worldwide."
_meta.source: Rita Izsák, UN Special Rapporteur on minority issues, Report A/HRC/31/56, 28 January 2016
_meta.licence: UN website terms allow "personal, non-commercial use, without any right to ... redistribute" (https://www.un.org/en/about-us/terms-of-use). This file holds only facts (country names, paragraph numbers, group names) and short quotes, with a link to the document, not the document itself.
_meta.citation: United Nations Human Rights Council (2016). Report of the Special Rapporteur on minority issues, A/HRC/31/56.
_meta.roles: caste-affected = described with a named group (paras 33-43); caste-affected (listed) = listed in para 44 without detail; diaspora = para 45
